body:
## Why (verified evidence)
The revision loop records scheduling intent but never acts on it. `resolve_revision_request` writes `request.scheduler_hook = _revision_scheduler_hook(...)` (`src/lms/feedback/repository.py:403`) with `reason_code` and `trigger` metadata (`src/lms/feedback/repository.py:242-253`). No production code reads `scheduler_hook` after persistence (repo-wide references are limited to `repository.py`, models, schemas, and export tests). `submit_revision_request` also stops after `create_attempt` (`src/lms/feedback/repository.py:371-386`) and never calls `schedule_for_evidence`, unlike `record_attempt` (`src/lms/evidence/service.py:72-74`) and rubric scoring (`src/lms/feedback/scoring.py:164`). On tip `3bdd840`, accepting a revised submission with scored evidence leaves **zero** `ReviewQueueItem` rows while `scheduler_hook` is populated.

## Tasks
- [ ] After a successful `submit_revision_request` with scored `evidence`, invoke the same scheduling seam used by `record_attempt` (`src/lms/evidence/service.py:72-74`) so revised attempts enqueue review/remediation when appropriate.
- [ ] In `resolve_revision_request` (`src/lms/feedback/repository.py:389-409`), consume `scheduler_hook` to enqueue or update `ReviewQueueItem` rows (mirror `schedule_from_attempt` inputs) instead of storing JSON only.
- [ ] Extend `tests/feedback/test_revision_requests.py` with an end-to-end assertion that accepted revisions create the expected queue item.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Named test: `test_revision_acceptance_enqueues_review_queue_item` asserting `submit_revision_request` + `resolve_revision_request(..., outcome="accepted")` with scored evidence creates at least one `ReviewQueueItem` for the learner with `reason_code="due-review"`.
- Deliberate-break → revert: remove the scheduling call added in `resolve_revision_request` / `submit_revision_request` → confirm `test_revision_acceptance_enqueues_review_queue_item` FAILS → revert.

## Non-Goals
- Do NOT change revision status transition rules in `_REVISION_REQUEST_TRANSITIONS`.
- Do NOT alter rubric scoring thresholds or automatic feedback templates.
- No scaffolding / TODO-only changes; every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Surfaced by Track D repo-audit refill 2026-09-22 @ `3bdd840`; verified by repo-wide `scheduler_hook` grep and live reproduction showing `queue_count 0` with a non-null hook._
